conclusion.label: endorses

report:
### Conclusion
The health claim is **true**. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) officially approved the Kyleena (19.5 mg levonorgestrel-releasing) intrauterine system for the prevention of pregnancy for up to five years.

### Summary of Evidence
* **FDA Indication:** The official FDA labeling states that Kyleena is indicated to prevent pregnancy for up to five years and should be removed or replaced at the end of five years if continued use is desired.
* **Clinical Efficacy:** FDA approval was supported by a Phase III clinical trial of 1,452 women aged 18 to 35. Over the five-year evaluation, Kyleena maintained greater than 99% efficacy per year of use, yielding a cumulative 5-year pregnancy rate of 1.45% (Pearl Index of 0.29).

### Sources
* **FDA Drug Label:** https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2016/208224s000lbl.pdf
* **DailyMed (NIH/FDA Package Insert):** https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/fda/fdaDrugXsl.cfm?setid=2e07c155-21e1-4781-9633-ce8bddd47080
* **Drugs.com FDA Approval History:** https://www.drugs.com/history/kyleena.html
* **Kyleena HCP Clinical Efficacy Summary:** https://www.kyleenahcp.com/media/2276/download
